description: This file defines a collection of string constants and some BigDecimal constants used throughout the loan product module of the Fineract project. It includes various parameter names, configuration keys, and other identifiers related to loan products, such as repayment, interest, disbursement, guarantees, and more.

classes.name: LoanProductConstants
classes.description: An interface containing constant string values and BigDecimal defaults used for configuring and referencing various loan product parameters within the Fineract loan module.
